peak.label: Peak season
peak.text: Most comfortable weather, highest prices. Book early.

summer.label: Hot season
summer.text: Hot and humid on the coast. Great for the hills and big festivals.

monsoon.label: Monsoon
monsoon.text: Heavy rain and lush green scenery. The traditional season for Ayurveda, with the lowest prices.

shoulder.label: Shoulder season
shoulder.text: Showers, fewer crowds and good value.
